newsitem.title: USA: ITT says construction disruption drag on 97.
newsitem.headline: ITT says construction disruption drag on 97.

text.p: ITT Corp said Friday that its 1997 gaming results could continue to be hurt by construction disruption as it expands its gaming outlets in Las Vegas and Atlantic City, N.J..
Its gaming earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization in the third quarter dropped to $76 million from $106 million.

ITT attributed the decline to results from its premium play business at both of its properties in Las Vegas, construction disruption at the Desert Inn in Las Vegas and increased competition in the Tunica, Miss., market.
However, the company said its outlook for its overall business "remains favorable."
The company said its hotel, information and entertainment businesses are showing strong growth compared with 1995.
